criteria.rationale: The trigger covers onboarding, architecture discovery, resumption, decision recall, and freshness maintenance, with explicit non-triggers.
Repository identity, instructions, project profile, current-state checkpoint, and relevant memory pages are explicit prerequisites.
The eight-step workflow is ordered and requires source verification, claim labels, checkpoint updates, and validation.
The required output enumerates inspected scope, retrieved pages/freshness, facts/assumptions/unknowns, evidence, and checkpoint changes.
Evidence authority, project isolation, privacy, stale-memory handling, and stop conditions are explicit.
Eight direct cases include three in-scope, two near-miss, and one edge label; evidence covers recall, authority, isolation, staleness, retrieval, and resumption.
